title: 第5章 夏明华的目的第6章 吃饭
lines: 第5章夏明华的目的
努力的拍了拍自己还在发烫的脸颊，让自己的那狂跳的心平缓了些许，这才想起来一个重要的事情。
自己没有失身吧！连忙掀开被子，见被子之下的自己，依旧穿着昨晚的晚礼服，这才拍了拍胸口放心了下来。
昨晚的一幕幕全都清晰无比的出现在她的脑海之中，就差像录像带一样可以倒退了。自己参加闺蜜的婚礼，然后她是伴娘，最后挡酒喝醉了。
杨素素给她开了房间，所以她就上来了，而不是在自己的家里，再然后她就再也想不起来了。
夏天掀开被子，朝窗户跨步走去，“唰……”将窗帘拉开，看到楼下的景色，确实是酒店的景色无异。
夏天哀叹，自己要不要这么衰？这是走错了房间的节奏？
丢脸死了，别人没有把她当成卖的给睡了都是好的。
就在夏天还在哀叹，而此刻的权天睿已经穿好衣服，从衣帽间走了出来，看到夏天光着脚在地上，不由的蹙眉。
“怎么不穿鞋？”
听到权天睿的话，夏天的脚趾头动了动，看着自己光着的脚丫子，貌似没有觉得有什么不对。刚刚起的太急，所以忘记了。
而且这里是总统套房，地毯也是极为名贵的，光着脚踩在上面很舒服。
不过看着权天睿黑着的脸，她觉得，估计是觉得自己的脚将他的地毯给弄脏了吧！毕竟有不少人有洁癖，这个夏天倒是理解的。
“哦，不好意思，我马上穿鞋。”
对于夏天的道歉，权天睿的眉头皱的越发的深了几分，瞧着她把拖鞋穿好，这才没有在说什么。
穿好鞋子，夏天看着自己身上还是昨夜参加婚礼穿的礼服，也明白，昨夜这个男人的绅士，虽然开始脸色并不好看，但是人家终究没有对自己怎么样，心里对这个男人的好感多了几分。
“昨晚，谢谢你了。”经历过刚才的事情，显然夏天有些局促，不敢抬头去看眼前的这个男人。
也不等他说话，直接提起床头的手提包，就朝门外跑了出去。
显然对于她的谢谢，权天睿很不满意，直接跨步上前，将夏天给拉了回来，直接用自己的身子将她禁锢在了门后。
而夏天这样的情况给惊住了。
“你不记得我？”
权天睿的话，让夏天有些疑惑。“我需要记得你么？”貌似他们以前也不认识啊！
听到夏天的话，权天睿的眼眸之中闪过一丝失落，随即便消失了，好似从未出现过一样。
“只要以后都记得我就是了。”
最后夏天走了之后都在莫名其妙的想自己在哪里见过这个男人，貌似在她的记忆力真的没有见过他吧！
毕竟对于男神的记忆，她向来都是蛮好的。
想了很久也没有想出个结果，到最后，她也只是当这一切是个美好的艳遇。
只是却不想，她再次见到这个男人的时候，会是在自己相亲的时候，更悲催的是，直接被拖去结了婚。
到现在夏天还是无比的幽怨，真的，她本来对他的君子行为感到蛮有好感的，但是看着自己现在身上这些淤青，好感什么的，已经随风去了，彻底的碎成了渣渣。
夏天收拾好自己手，给自己画了一个浅浅的淡妆，顺便帮脖子上那些吻痕也给盖了盖，不然她今天就别想出门了。
刚刚完成好一切之后，夏天这才下楼。
content_en:
Chapter 5 Xia Minghua’s Purpose
I tried my best to pat my still hot cheeks to calm down my racing heart a little, and then I remembered an important thing.
Didn't you lose your virginity? He quickly opened the quilt and saw that he was still wearing the evening dress from last night under the quilt. Then he patted his chest and felt relieved.
The scenes from last night all appeared in her mind so clearly that it was almost like a video tape that could be played back. I attended my best friend's wedding, and she was the bridesmaid, and ended up getting drunk.
Yang Susu opened a room for her, so she came up here instead of at home, and then she couldn't remember it anymore.
Xia Tian opened the quilt and stepped towards the window. "Wow..." He opened the curtains and saw the scenery downstairs. It was indeed the scenery of a hotel.
Xia Tian lamented, should he be so weak? Is this the rhythm of the wrong room?
It's so embarrassing. It's a good thing that others don't treat her as a piece of cake and sleep with her.
Just as Xia Tian was still lamenting, Quan Tianrui had already put on his clothes and walked out of the cloakroom. When he saw Xia Tian's bare feet on the ground, he couldn't help but frown.
"Why don't you wear shoes?"
Hearing Quan Tianrui's words, Xia Tian moved his toes and looked at his bare feet, seemingly not feeling anything wrong. I was in such a hurry just now that I forgot about it.
Moreover, this is the presidential suite, and the carpet is extremely expensive, and it is very comfortable to step on with bare feet.
But looking at Quan Tianrui's dark face, she felt that her feet might have soiled his carpet! After all, many people have mysophobia, and this Xia Tian understands it.
"Oh, sorry, I'll put on my shoes right away."
Regarding Xia Tian's apology, Quan Tianrui's brows furrowed even deeper, and he didn't say anything as he watched her put on her slippers.
After putting on her shoes, Xia Tian saw that she was still wearing the dress she wore to attend the wedding last night, and she also understood that the man last night was a gentleman. Although his face didn't look good at first, he didn't do anything to her after all, and she felt a little better about this man in her heart.
"Thank you for last night." After experiencing what happened just now, Xia Tian was obviously a little embarrassed and did not dare to raise his head to look at the man in front of him.
Without waiting for him to speak, he directly picked up the handbag on the bedside and ran out the door.
Obviously, Quan Tianrui was not satisfied with her thank you. He stepped forward, pulled Xia Tian back, and imprisoned her behind the door with his own body.
And Xia Tian was shocked by this situation.
"You don't remember me?"
Quan Tianrui's words made Xia Tian a little confused. "Do I need to remember you?" It seems like they didn't know each other before!
Hearing Xia Tian's words, Quan Tianrui's eyes flashed with a trace of disappointment, and then disappeared, as if he had never appeared.
"As long as you remember me from now on."
In the end, after Xia Tian left, she was inexplicably thinking about where she had seen this man. It seemed that she had never seen him in her memory!
After all, she has always had a good memory of her male god.
After thinking about it for a long time, she couldn't come up with a result. In the end, she just regarded it as a beautiful affair.
But she didn't expect that when she saw this man again, it would be during her blind date, and what was even more tragic was that she would be dragged directly to get married.
Even now, Xia Tian is still extremely resentful. Really, she originally felt quite fond of his gentlemanly behavior, but looking at the bruises on her body, her good feelings have gone with the wind and completely shattered into pieces.
Xia Tian packed up her hands, applied a light makeup on herself, and also covered the hickeys on her neck, otherwise she wouldn't be able to go out today.
After just finishing everything, Xia Tian went downstairs.
